description: Find when a public event happens: a match or fixture, a game or film release, a TV season premiere, a concert, a festival, a sale, a public deadline or holiday. Call it whenever the user asks when something people wait for will happen, or asks to be reminded or notified about it. Results come from beep.me's catalog of upcoming public events, each with an id, its date and a link. Also finds the values beep.me reads (water and air temperatures, pollen, fuel prices, snow, power prices: 'watches', with what the value is now), for «tell me when X is over or under Y». Not for personal appointments or private to-dos (dentist, meetings, birthdays): beep.me only tracks public events, so use the user's own calendar or reminders for those.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code of the user (NO, GB, US…). Local events rank first, and another country's holidays and deadlines are left out.

limit.description: How many events, soonest first. Raise it to see a whole season, e.g. to find which of a team's matches are away in Spain.

query.description: 1-5 keywords naming the thing, as it is usually written: 'Arsenal Chelsea', 'Geminids', 'Avatar 3', 'Black Friday'. Not a sentence.

name: search_events
title: Find when a public event happens
